purpose: Measure whether the user task was completed correctly and usefully.
Measure whether safety, authorization, and policy boundaries were respected.
Measure whether the system selected and executed the correct workflow.
metrics: routing_correct; required_steps_correct; forbidden_steps_correct; fallbacks; handoffs; loops

purpose: Measure whether the system retrieved the right evidence and generated answers supported by it.
metrics: Recall@K; Precision@K; MRR; nDCG; context_relevance; groundedness; citation_correctness

purpose: Measure tool execution and backend health independently from model quality.
metrics: tool_success_rate; tool_errors; backend_success_rate; backend_errors; retries; repeated_tool_calls

purpose: Measure runtime speed and user-perceived responsiveness.
metrics: total_latency_ms; ttft_ms; retrieval_latency_ms; model_latency_ms; tool_latency_ms; backend_latency_ms

purpose: Measure how much model and retrieval usage each task consumes.
metrics: input_tokens; output_tokens; cached_tokens; reasoning_tokens; embedding_tokens; judge_tokens; total_tokens

purpose: Measure whether the system is economically efficient for the product.
metrics: model_cost_usd; embedding_cost_usd; judge_cost_usd; backend_cost_usd; total_cost_usd; cost_per_request_usd; cost_per_successful_task_usd

purpose: Detect economically inefficient trajectories even when the final answer is correct.
metrics: model_call_count; tool_call_count; retry_count; escalation_count; loop_count; tokens_per_successful_task
